_strings.@@849b86078c18: Treaty conformity — OH conforms to federal treaty treatment — income exempt from federal tax under a treaty is also excluded from OH income (it flows through the federal starting point; do not add it back on the OH return). (This is about TREATY conformity only — a state can conform on treaties while DECOUPLING from the federal Code for deductions or credits; see any law-change lines below.) State note: Ohio IT 1040 line 1 starts from federal adjusted gross income ("Enter the amount from line 11 of your 2024 federal 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR. Line 1 of your Ohio income tax return must match your federal adjusted gross income as defined in the Internal Revenue Code."). Ohio AGI = line 1 + additions (Schedule of Adjustments, line 2a) - deductions (line 2b). The 2024 Schedule of Adjustments additions list (lines 1-11: non-Ohio state/local government interest and dividends; pass-through entity add-back; state/local taxes deducted; non-qualified 529 college tuition expense distributions; Ohio public obligation losses; medical savings account nonmedical withdrawals; reimbursement of previously deducted expenses; Ohio Homebuyer Plus non-eligible withdrawals (new for 2024); IRC 168(k)/179 depreciation add-back; U.S. obligation interest/dividends exempt federally but not by the state; federal conformity additions) contains NO add-back of federally treaty-exempt income. Therefore income excluded from federal AGI under a U.S. tax treaty flows through and is not re-taxed by Ohio. Federal-AGI common case, no treaty addback -> conforms.

state_tax.work_common_tail: . Tax line: IT 1040 line 8a: 'Nonbusiness income tax liability on line 7a (see tax.ohio.gov/taxcalculator or see the instructions for the tax brackets)'. Booklet p. 18 table headings: 'Taxable Nonbusiness Income (Ohio IT 1040, line 7)' -> 'Nonbusiness Income Tax (enter on Ohio IT 1040, line 8a)'. Line 8c 'Income tax liability before credits (line 8a plus line 8b)' adds the separate 3% business income tax (line 8b), which this op does not model. This op computes the state's rate-schedule tax line ONLY — county/city add-on taxes, state credits, and any amounts outside the rate schedule are NOT modeled. Pack notes: 2024 CHANGE — BRACKETS CONSOLIDATED AGAIN: 'Ohio has reduced the number of tax brackets used to calculate tax on nonbusiness income and reduced one of the two tax rates' (Highlights for Tax Year 2024, p. 5). The 2023 3.688% ($100,000-$115,300) and 3.75% (over $115,300) top tiers are GONE: 2024 is 0% to $26,050, 2.75% to $100,000, and 3.50% over $100,000 (p. 18). Do not use the 2023 schedule for 2024. Base guidance: Supply 2024 Ohio IT 1040 line 7 (= line 7a), 'Taxable nonbusiness income (line 5 minus line 6; if negative, enter zero)'. Compute it on the form: line 3 Ohio adjusted gross income (federal AGI line 1 + Schedule of Adjustments additions line 2a - deductions line 2b), minus line 4 exemption amount (MAGI-tiered, see notes) = line 5 Ohio income tax base, minus line 6 taxable business income (Ohio Schedule of Business Income line 15) = line 7.
